skills.title: Old password still stored somewhere
skills.trigger: Failures start soon after a password change, concentrated on one or two internal hosts, wrong-password codes, regular cadence.

skills.title: Possible password guessing from many sources
skills.trigger: Many distinct source hosts or any external source IPs, wrong-password codes, short burst, no password change that explains it.

skills.title: Not enough evidence to explain
skills.trigger: No failures in the window, or a log source is missing, or no other skill fits clearly.
